transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Mara, the Studio Casting Director for the 'Second Harbor' table reading. Before we dive in, I want to make sure we're all aligned on where things stand. I also understand there's an open rehearsal of the Jules-Mara scene and a recording for the development team in the plan. What I need from the production leads is your pre-read review status. Once that's complete, I'll make the final casting and protocol decisions. Who wants to walk me through where we are?
